title: Stored prompt
description: One prompt in the prompt library - the text a workflow loads with a 'prompt:' reference, plus the metadata the library pages show.

text.description: The prompt text itself - what a 'prompt:' reference resolves to. May not begin with a reference prefix ('previous_result:', 'variable:', 'constant:', 'prompt:').

description.description: Short summary shown on the prompt's library card.

intended_model.description: The model or model family the prompt was written for, such as 'minimax-h3'. Informational - the engine ignores it, but the library badges and filters by it and the enhancer uses it to preselect a preset.

negative_prompt.description: A negative prompt paired with the text, for models that take one.

tags.description: Free-form labels for filtering the library.

enhanced.description: Provenance when the text came from the AI enhancer - which model expanded which idea.

model.description: The LLM that generated the text.

idea.description: The idea the text was expanded from.
